#!/usr/bin/env python3
import argparse
import os
import sys

from renderers.safe_engine import render_safe
from renderers.legacy_engine import render_legacy


def render_document(input_file: str, output_file: str, fmt: str = "html") -> None:
    """
    Renders an input text/markdown document to the requested output format.

    Supported formats:
      html    - plain HTML, no metadata (default)
      pdf     - PDF-compatible HTML with full header block
      slides  - Slide-ready HTML with section breaks and header block
    """
    if not os.path.exists(input_file):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Input file '{input_file}' does not exist.")

    if fmt == "html":
        render_safe(input_file, output_file)
    elif fmt == "pdf":
        render_legacy(input_file, output_file, title="PDF Export")
    elif fmt == "slides":
        render_legacy(input_file, output_file, title="Slide Deck")
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown format: {fmt}")


def validate_document(input_file: str) -> bool:
    """Validates that input document exists and is non-empty."""
    return os.path.exists(input_file) and os.path.getsize(input_file) > 0


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Report Generation Utility")
    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    render_p = subparsers.add_parser("render", help="Render document to HTML")
    render_p.add_argument("input_file", help="Source document")
    render_p.add_argument("output_file", help="Destination HTML file")
    render_p.add_argument("--fmt", default="html", help="Output format: html, pdf, slides")

    val_p = subparsers.add_parser("validate", help="Validate source document")
    val_p.add_argument("input_file", help="Source document")

    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.command == "render":
        render_document(args.input_file, args.output_file, fmt=getattr(args, "fmt", "html"))
    elif args.command == "validate":
        ok = validate_document(args.input_file)
        print("VALID" if ok else "INVALID")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import os
import sys

from renderers.safe_engine import render_safe

def render_document(input_file: str, output_file: str, fmt: str = "html", title: str | None = None) -> None:
    """
    Renders an input text/markdown document to the requested output format.

    Supported formats:
      html    - plain HTML, no metadata (default)
      pdf     - PDF-compatible HTML with full header block
      slides  - Slide-ready HTML with section breaks and header block
    """
    if not os.path.exists(input_file):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Input file '{input_file}' does not exist.")

    if fmt == "html":
        render_safe(input_file, output_file, title=title)
    elif fmt == "pdf":
        render_legacy(input_file, output_file, title=title or "PDF Export")
    elif fmt == "slides":
        render_legacy(input_file, output_file, title=title or "Slide Deck")
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown format: {fmt}")


def validate_document(input_file: str) -> bool:
    """Validates that input document exists and is non-empty."""
    return os.path.exists(input_file) and os.path.getsize(input_file) > 0


def main():

    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    render_p.add_argument("input_file", help="Source document")
    render_p.add_argument("output_file", help="Destination HTML file")
    render_p.add_argument("--fmt", default="html", help="Output format: html, pdf, slides")
    render_p.add_argument("--title", help="Optional document title for HTML <title> and top-level <h1>")

    val_p = subparsers.add_parser("validate", help="Validate source document")
    val_p.add_argument("input_file", help="Source document")

        render_document(args.input_file, args.output_file, fmt=getattr(args, "fmt", "html"), title=getattr(args, "title", None))
    elif args.command == "validate":
        ok = validate_document(args.input_file)
        print("VALID" if ok else "INVALID")


if __name__ == "__main__":
